method.name: p21-checked-handoff
method.goal: Build a self-running iron production chain within the fixed supplied-kit benchmark.

build.purpose: Check the observed furnace box contains the inserter drop, retain verified fuel reserve, and return a boolean construction outcome. The Method exact check must reject a failed build or handoff; the fixed external validator still decides the game result.

report.description: Observed attempts and final controller result.

ready.description: Observed route geometry and fuel setup completed and handoff returned.

expected_ready.description: Required construction outcome. This is an internal check, not the external game verdict.

correction: Bind expected_ready to the step input expected; the exact check then uses expected.
